name: Hardt
source:
"I wanted to talk to you alone!"

Stands at the top of "Pistole Magier" and is the twin brother of Borc.

Contrary to his appearance, he's ruthless and harsh towards anyone other than his younger brother.

[Translated from [url=https://blulunetta.web.fc2.com/pistole/story.html#hardt]official website[/url]]
